blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The city council here returned a ₱470-million garbage-processing proposal to Mayor Nestor Archival’s Office after Vice Mayor Tomas Osmeña questioned why the latest supplier quotation was ₱220 million higher than an earlier price he said he had negotiated. During its regular session earlier this week, the city council referred Suki Trading Corp.’s letter of intent back to the Mayor’s Office, along with concerns raised by Osmeña and other councilors. Osmeña said he had previously worked with Suki Trading on a garbage-processing solution and had received a ₱250-million quotation in January. He added that the supplier’s September 22 […]...
